subject: vision model accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently worked with Sewer AI on real-time defect classification across
cameras and sensors in variable lighting and conditions - similar scale
challenges to what you're running at AMP.

One pattern we see when tracking billions of objects: edge cases and new
material types outgrow internal annotation tooling fast, and QA becomes the
drag on iteration speed.

Quick context, Encord (Series C, $110M raised) helps physical AI teams
building advanced computer vision and multimodal pipelines such as Boston
Dynamics, Pi, Dyna Robotics to improve model accuracy.

Would love to show you our platform and get your feedback. Open to taking a
quick look next week?

subject: [NAME] - CV pipeline
text:
Hi [NAME], 

        I believe you've built a thoughtful annotation workflow at 
        [COMPANY], especially around pose estimation and movement tracking in production. 

        We've been spending time with teams running large-scale human motion + video pipelines (e.g. across healthcare and sports performance) who are now focused less on toolinging and more on tightening model eval loops and surfacing edge cases systematically. 

        Curious how you're approaching eval, QA, and workflow scalability as your volumes grow. If helpful, I can share how teams like Mayo Clinic, Iterative Health and 
        viz.ai are switching to Encord for our native video annotation capabilities. 

        Open to a quick 20-min chat and see what it would look like for your projects?

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME], 

        Huge congrats on closing your first year public with those amazing numbers!

        I noticed you are hiring CV and data scientists across SF, Montreal, and Bangalore. That kind of growth usually means annotation volumes, eval complexity and data pipeline overhead are all scaling in parallel. 

        For teams working on pose estimation and keypoint tracking in real-world environments, the friction we often hear about is around training data quality, temporal consistency in video, and keeping clinician-in-the-loop tight without slowing model iteration. 

        If scaling motion datasets and annotation efficiency is top of mind for 
        [COMPANY] this year, I'd love a quick chat to introduce Encord to you - open to a 20min this or next week?
